verdict.rationale: Runloop's homepage claims a concrete performance number — '10GB image startup time in <2s' — directly supporting sub-second-to-few-second cold starts, plus snapshot/blueprint mechanisms that support fast provisioning. However this is a single first-party marketing claim rather than detailed documented benchmarks or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: dedicated docs page with reproducible cold-start benchmarks across image sizes, independent/hands-on verification of startup latency, and clarity on cold start vs snapshot-restore timing.
